purpose: Maintainer-only provenance registry for target-exam reading baselines. It deliberately contains no examination passages and does not control generation or validation.

corpusAdmissionPolicy.activationArtifact: For each active track, retain only a versioned derived-statistics record: source and derived SHA-256, source permission, tokenizer and UDPipe metric schema, sample counts, distribution quantiles, and build-script version.

sources.title: Academic word coverage and language difficulty of reading passages in College English Test and Test of English for Academic Purposes in China
sources.attribution: Liu H, Shi X, Qiu J, Shi Y, Hao Y, Zhu L, Yan C and Li H (2023), Frontiers in Psychology 14:1171227, CC BY 4.0.

derivedStatistics.method: Academic Word List coverage reported by the paper; this is not NAWL coverage and is not a substitute for the app's lexicon layers.
derivedStatistics.corpusScope: Reading comprehension Sections A, B and C; questions excluded; December 2013 through December 2021.

limitations: The paper does not grant this app a corpus of passages; only its CC BY paper and reported aggregates are recorded.
Its AWL and Flesch-Kincaid methodology cannot produce app UDPipe dependency metrics without a separately licensed corpus and a reproducible same-metric pipeline.
The study covers 2013-2021 and only reading passages.

sources.title: 考研英语一与考研英语二阅读理解A部分文本复杂度对比研究

derivedStatistics.method: Coh-Metrix 3.0, Web Vocab Profile and SPSS as reported by the paper. The reported Coh-Metrix indicators are not app UDPipe metrics.
derivedStatistics.corpusScope: Reading Comprehension Part A, 2018-2022, twenty texts for each track (forty total).

limitations: Only Reading Part A and five years are included; no full historical corpus is delivered to the app.
Mean Reading A bundle length refers to the paper's test-level measurement, not an individual app article target.
Coh-Metrix PCSYN values cannot be translated into UDPipe dependency depth, subordinate rate, passive rate or non-finite rate without a matched corpus run.
